outcome: maternal symptoms (body pain/myalgia, fatigue, headache, shivering)
cohort: The cohort included 769 pregnant women (107 with COVID-19 and 662 without COVID-19) referred to Asalian Hospital in Khorramabad city, western Iran.
finding: COVID-19 infection during pregnancy was associated with a higher rate of caesarean section, but did not result in other adverse maternal or neonatal outcomes compared to non-infected mothers.
mod_finding: The risk of caesarean section was 3.2 times higher in pregnant women with COVID-19 compared to those without.
cross-section timing: Data collected from February 2020 to July 2021
